Prompt Scheduler (4A Prompt Manager).description: Expands folder wildcard prompts sequentially or randomly for each batch item, then outputs positive, negative, and structured prompt data.

config_json.tooltip: Configuration JSON for the frontend prompt columns and negative prompt.

execution_index.tooltip: Zero-based position of this execution within the batch.

run_id.tooltip: Run identifier that keeps the folder snapshot consistent within a batch.

Prompt Display (4A Prompt Manager).description: Loads prompt, inference, and LoRA metadata from images, then displays resolved columns as selectable read-only text.

imported_json.name: Imported JSON
imported_json.tooltip: Prompt metadata JSON imported from an image or external source.

prompt_json.name: Prompt JSON

Meta Apply (4A Prompt Manager).description: Drop or pick an image to apply detected metadata. Use the top toggles to enable model, LoRA, inference parameters, and prompt independently.

Input Parameters (4A Prompt Manager).description: Outputs sampler parameters, independent width and height values, and portable JSON metadata. The ratio preset only provides one-shot frontend sizing.

width.name: Width
width.tooltip: Output image width, rounded to a multiple of 8.

height.name: Height
height.tooltip: Output image height, rounded to a multiple of 8.

Bypass Switch (4A Prompt Manager).description: Wire nodes you want to control into the inputs. When enabled is false those nodes are set to Bypass; when true they return to Always. Useful for toggling a second-sample subgraph.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.tooltip: When on, connected nodes run normally; when off, they are bypassed.
